from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
import glob, hashlib, numpy as np
def rgba(p): return np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'))
def alpha_summary(p):
 a=rgba(p)[:,:,3]; ys,xs=np.where(a>0); bbox=(int(xs.min()),int(ys.min()),int(xs.max())+1,int(ys.max())+1); x0,y0,x1,y1=bbox; r=a[y0:y1,x0:x1]
 return bbox, float((r>0).mean()), float((r>=128).mean()), float((r>=240).mean()), float(r.mean()), hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for p in ['augen_blink/blink_000.png','augen_blink/blink_006.png','augen_blink/blink_011.png','augen_gaze/rotglow_tracking_master.png']:
 im=Image.open(p); b,nz,a128,a240,mean,h=alpha_summary(p); print('ASSET',p,'SIZE',im.size,'BBOX',b,'ROI_NZ',round(nz,6),'ROI_A128',round(a128,6),'ROI_A240',round(a240,6),'ROI_AMEAN',round(mean,3),'SHA',h)
blink=sorted(glob.glob('augen_blink/blink_*.png')); aa=[rgba(p)[:,:,3] for p in blink]; u=np.maximum.reduce(aa); ys,xs=np.where(u>0); ub=(int(xs.min()),int(ys.min()),int(xs.max())+1,int(ys.max())+1); x0,y0,x1,y1=ub
print('BLINK_COUNT',len(blink),'UNION_BBOX',ub)
base=rgba('augen_blink/blink_000.png'); ar=base[y0:y1,x0:x1,3]; print('BASE_IN_UNION','NZ',round(float((ar>0).mean()),6),'A128',round(float((ar>=128).mean()),6),'A240',round(float((ar>=240).mean()),6),'MEAN',round(float(ar.mean()),3))
expr=sorted(glob.glob('ausdruck_erweitert/*/*/frontal/stufe_*.png')); print('EXPR_COUNT',len(expr)); from collections import Counter; print('EXPR_SIZES',dict(Counter(Image.open(p).size for p in expr)))
# For each expression frame report whether eye-plate high-alpha pixels would cover existing opaque expression pixels.
mask=base[:,:,3]>=240; denom=int(mask.sum()); covered=[]; diffs=[]
base_rgb=base[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)
for p in expr:
 e=rgba(p); ok=e.shape==base.shape;
 if not ok: continue
 ea=e[:,:,3]; covered.append(float((ea[mask]>=240).mean()) if denom else 0.0)
 diffs.append(float(np.abs(e[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)-base_rgb)[mask].mean()) if denom else 0.0)
print('EXPR_MATCHING_CANVAS',len(covered),'OF',len(expr))
if covered: print('UNDER_PLATE_EXPR_OPAQUE_FRAC_MIN_MED_MAX',round(min(covered),6),round(float(np.median(covered)),6),round(max(covered),6))
if diffs: print('EXPR_VS_CANONICAL_RGB_MAD_ON_PLATE_MIN_MED_MAX',round(min(diffs),3),round(float(np.median(diffs)),3),round(max(diffs),3))
# Plate feasibility: fully opaque canonical pixels are deterministic overwrites regardless of underlying expression.
print('CANONICAL_PLATE_FULLY_OPAQUE_PIXELS',denom,'TOTAL_PIXELS',base.shape[0]*base.shape[1])
print('SCOPE=READ_ONLY_EYE_PLATE_ALPHA_METRICS')
